# ChoZen Boutique

> Florist and gift boutique in Enfield, London. Fresh flowers and balloon gift sets, made up in Enfield and hand-delivered the same day across North London when ordered by 10am. Faux flowers, crystals and gemstone jewellery are posted anywhere in the UK. Run by Beyzan.

## Shop
- [Same-day flowers](https://www.chozenboutique.co.uk/collections/same-day-flowers): bouquets hand-delivered the same day in Enfield and North London
- [Balloon gift sets](https://www.chozenboutique.co.uk/collections/balloon-gift-sets): balloons alone or with flowers, delivered together
- [Gifts that last](https://www.chozenboutique.co.uk/collections/gifts-that-last): faux flowers, crystals and gemstone jewellery, posted UK-wide
- [Sympathy flowers](https://www.chozenboutique.co.uk/collections/sympathy-flowers)
